name: kong-chat-bridge
description: Connect VS Code chat model requests to self-hosted or custom model endpoints through Kong API gateway.

commands.title: Generate Commit Message with Kong-chat-bridge - Stop

kong-chat-bridge.logLevel.description: Debug log level. Logs are written to ~/.kong/kong-chat-bridge/logs/ as JSON lines. Default is 'off' (no logging).

kong-chat-bridge.baseUrl.description: The base URL for the Openai Compatible Inference API. Default value is Hugging Face.

displayName.description: (Optional) Display name for the model that will be shown in the host interface. If not provided, will be generated automatically.

configId.description: (Optional) Configuration ID for this model. Allows defining the same model with different settings (e.g. 'glm-4.6::thinking', 'glm-4.6::no-thinking').

family.description: Model family (e.g., 'gpt-4', 'claude-3', 'gemini'). Enables model-specific optimizations and behaviors. Defaults to 'oai-compatible' if not specified.

baseUrl.description: Base URL for the model provider. If not provided, the global kong-chat-bridge.baseUrl will be used.

context_length.description: Model support context length. Default is 128000.

vision.description: Model support vision. Default is false.

max_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate (range: [1, context_length)). Default is 4096.

max_completion_tokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate (OpenAI new standard parameter).

reasoning_effort.description: Default reasoning effort level for OpenAI-compatible requests. Leave empty to hide the host picker.

type.description: Set to 'enabled' to enable thinking, 'disabled' to disable thinking

enable_thinking.description: Switches between thinking and non-thinking modes. Not required.

thinking_budget.description: Maximum number of tokens for chain-of-thought output. Not required.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature (range: [0, 2]). Lower values make output more deterministic, higher values make it more creative. Default is 0.

top_k.description: Top-k sampling value (range: [1, Infinity)). Not required.

effort.description: Reasoning effort level for OpenRouter/xAI (high, medium, low, minimal, auto)

exclude.description: Exclude reasoning tokens from the final response

max_tokens.description: Specific token limit for reasoning (Anthropic-style, alternative to effort)

enabled.description: Enable reasoning (inferred from effort or max_tokens if not specified)

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers to be sent with every request to this model's provider. These headers will be merged with the default headers (Authorization, Content-Type, User-Agent).

include_reasoning_in_request.description: Whether to include reasoning_content in assistant messages sent to the API. Support deepseek-v3.2 or others.

apiMode.description: API mode: 'openai' (Default) for OpenAI Chat Completions (/chat/completions), 'openai-responses' for OpenAI Responses (/responses), 'openai-responses-ws' for OpenAI Responses over a reused per-run WebSocket (kong-style upstreams; auto-falls back to 'openai-responses' on handshake/protocol error), 'ollama' for Ollama (/api/chat), 'anthropic' for Anthropic (/v1/messages), 'gemini' for Gemini (*/v1beta/models/{model}:streamGenerateContent?alt=sse).

useForCommitGeneration.description: Whether to be used for Git commit message generation. Not supports gemini apiMode.

delay.description: Model-specific delay in milliseconds between consecutive requests. If not specified, falls back to global kong-chat-bridge.delay configuration.

cache_control.description: Enable Anthropic prompt-caching breakpoints (apiMode='anthropic' only). When true, attaches cache_control={type:'ephemeral'} to the system prompt and the last tool definition, and forwards any in-message cache_control markers emitted by the host. Set to false for upstream providers that reject the cache_control field.

kong-chat-bridge.models.description: A list of preferred models to use. If provided, these models will be used directly instead of fetching from the API.

kong-chat-bridge.copilotUtilitySmallFall.description: Optional explicit model ID used to satisfy Copilot's gpt-4o-mini utility-small family selection. Leave empty to avoid advertising any compatibility alias.

enabled.description: Enable retry mechanism for api errors. Default is true.

max_attempts.description: Maximum number of retry attempts. Default is 3.

interval_ms.description: Interval between retry attempts in milliseconds. Default is 1000 (1 seconds).

status_codes.description: Additional HTTP status codes that will be merged. Default is [429, 500, 502, 503, 504].

kong-chat-bridge.retry.description: Retry configuration for handling api errors like [429, 500, 502, 503, 504].

kong-chat-bridge.delay.description: Fixed delay in milliseconds between consecutive requests. Default is 0 (no delay).

kong-chat-bridge.commitLanguage.description: Language for generated Git commit messages. Default is English.

kong-chat-bridge.commitMessagePrompt.description: Custom system prompt for commit message generation. If not provided, uses the default prompt.

kong-chat-bridge.readFileLines.description: Number of lines to read when using `read_file` tool. Large lines may cost more tokens. Default is 0, let model decide lines.
